sections.en: 2 οἱ δὲ ('but they') the codices have; corrected. 3 τὰ τοιαῦτα ('such things') A : ταῦτα ('these things') M. 7 It ought to be ἀποδεικνύασιν ('they demonstrate'). ἄλλοις ἄλλων γίνεσθαι ('to become of others for others') the codices have; corrected by Kroll and Bidez. 9 καὶ ('and') (the second) omitted by M. 10 ἐνίοις ('in some') the codices have; corrected. περιγράμματα ('outlines') = περιγραφάς ('circumscriptions') "circumventiones" [Kroll]. 12 ῥύσεται ('will flow') the codices have. 13 Ἡλίου ('of the Sun') M : Ἄρεως ('of Mars') A (with astrological signs). 14 λαθημαίας ('secret') A : λήθην ποιήσει διὰ τῶν μαίων ('will cause forgetfulness through the midwives') M, which seems to be an explanation of the scribe; corrected by Bidez : λαθριμαῖος ('secret') "clandestinus" in the glossary. σκέπας ('cover') M. δυσπιστίας ('of distrust') conjectured by Bidez who supplied ποιοῦντες ('making') before σκεπάσουσιν ('they will cover'). 18 ὑποτυφλόμεναι ('being somewhat blind') A. 20 γίνεται ('becomes') corrected; γίνονται ('become') the codices have. κοιλαίνειν ('to hollow out') A : κινεῖσθαι ('to be moved') written above, variant reading κοιλαίνειν ('to hollow out') M : κυμαίνειν ('to undulate') conjectured by Bidez. 21 τε ('and') deleted by Kroll. 22 Ἄρης ('Mars') A : Ἑρμῆς ('Mercury') M. 23 περὶ ποντοτέρους ('about more sea-like') A : περιπονωτέρους ('more distressed') M; corrected. 29 λατρώδη ('servile')] Concerning these signs, cf. Catal., I, p. 166, 25. 30 ὡς προείπομεν ('as we said before')] Nothing of the sort above. Therefore is the text lacunose? σπάδοντος ('of a eunuch') the codices have. ἀκόπους ('untiring') the codices have : ἀτόκους ('childless') conjectured : ἀποκόπους ('castrated') Kroll. 32 δυσιδαιμονοῦντας ('being unfortunate') A.

summary.headline: Astrological Sexual Indications
summary.text: Astrological doctrine on sexual passions and licentious conduct attributed to configurations of Venus, Mars, Saturn, and Jupiter, including squares, oppositions, risings, settings, culminations, and angular positions. The passage describes indications of tribadism, bestiality, eunuchism, castration, barrenness, celibacy, and sexual superstition.
